attributes.name: Blessing of Dispater
attributes.powers:
Discard this card to add 1 die to any check.

Discard this card to add 2 dice to any check by a character at your location; if this card has the Corrupted trait, shuffle a boon into your location deck.

Discard this card to explore your location.

After you play this card, if the top card of the blessings discard pile has the Corrupted trait, recharge this card instead of discarding it.
